mission.title: Acceptable Levels
mission.description: Attend Halborn's meeting with the Machines, then keep Zion off his trail as Carlyne closes in.

npc.say:
... Giving me a whole lot of crap I already know. I can't believe the incompetence...
Damn it, just more of my time they've wasted.
Please, tesoro. The situation is developing very quickly.
Confirmed. Operative is leaving the building.

When I'm done with this, you can bet your ass that I'll be having another talk with the old man and his little harem. I'll have all the time in the world then to make damn sure they're playing me square.
I see you still haven't learned. I won't let you off as easily this time.

phase.briefing:
Operative, despite our success against terrorist incursions in Richland, Halborn has thus far failed in his attempts to locate the Oracle. This may be what has prompted him to request yet another meeting with our representatives.
You are appointed to attend this meeting. I will expect a full report and analysis.

enter.say: It's you, Halborn, and some of the top brass again. Huh... Doesn't look like Gray's showing up this time, though.

talk.say: I can't find the old woman, I don't have time to keep beating around back-alleys. Obviously she's another program you've managed to lose control over, but you must have some kind of tracking data. Where is she?

We have delivered reports to you on her movements. That is all the information we are able to provide. The...unpredictability of her actions was a design choice necessitated by our commitment to maintain the human population at a level capable of reasonably ensuring the preservation of your species' genetic polymorphism.

done.say: Hey... Don't look now, but I think Agent Pace is giving you the eye.

talk.say: Leave the building, and stand by for immediate deployment, operative.

phase.briefing:
Although reports of her presence in other areas have surfaced, the Oracle's past activity indicates a high probability that she will return to Richland, if she has not already done so. Halborn's enemy, Carlyne, is also in the Richland area, where he has been actively pursuing Halborn.
Your observation of Halborn indicates increasing anxiety on his part. This cannot go unmonitored. We have been able to track him since he left the meeting. You are to go to his location, and evaluate the situation.

enter.say:
So Halborn's cracking up, and we have front row seats to ground zero. Just another day on the job...
Okay, he's supposed to be in there. I've got override activity all over the place. I've also been picking up redpill readings here and there, so we could get some party crashers.

talk.say:
You think I don't know what's going on? Hah. Your masters don't have the balls for this. They want me to take care of it all, so they keep their hands clean.
If that's the way they want to play it, fine. Isn't worth my time trying to get them to man up--not with that bastard on my tail.

phase.briefing:
I see... Halborn's willingness to pose a continuing threat to the simulation is a concern. It will be necessary to take that into account.
Operative, you are in position to intercept another incoming Zion attack force. Prevent them from reaching Halborn.
Fortunately, Carlyne does not appear to be in that immediate area. We are continuing our scans to pinpoint his location.

enter.say:
Darn, I was kind of hoping it'd be some more EPN.
Well, better than nothing. I've got the reds showing on my scan. They're all yours.

phase.briefing:
Operative, Carlyne has been detected on a direct course for Halborn. The projected interception point is marked for you.
Interference in the area is causing a delay in reaching our other units. Proceed to the interception point immediately, and report on the situation.

enter.say:
Oh man, I'm picking up ridiculous code activity in there. Feedback's heading toward the red... Damn, there goes monitor three! Just had that one replaced, too...
Better get in there and look around fast. Dunno how much longer I can hold transmission...

talk.say: Be a sport, and don't run off, hm? It's been getting a little tiresome.
I see you still haven't learned. I won't let you off as easily this time.

done.say: {player}, I'm in the red here, buddy.

Shee-oot! Emergency shutdown sequence just tried to kick in...
&#@#! Feed's gonna abort any second now. Hell with the report! Get out of there!

mission.finish:
... {player} ...
... lost ... entire sector ...
... evacuate ... repeat ... area immediately ...
